findings.text: Provides hyp helper that resolves deferred guest program counter action by preferring exception injection when pending flag present and otherwise single instruction skip when increment flag present, clearing consumed flags.
Provides AArch32 instruction skip that advances program counter by halfword for compressed Thumb encoding or word otherwise, then advances interruptible Thumb block state.

Provides nested transition hook that re-evaluates enabled performance counters and rebuilds backing events where guest EL1 and EL2 counting permission differ, restoring guest state once if any rebuild occurred.
Reports whether a counter index belongs to hypervisor reserved set by testing membership in per virtual CPU hyp mask.
Provides stage2 unmap entry that does nothing for protected virtual machines and otherwise removes second stage mappings over a physical range with caller controlled blocking permission.

EL1 view writes target EL12 aliases for SCTLR and CPACR and TTBR0 and TTBR1 and TCR and TCR2 and PIR and PIRE0 and POR and ESR and AFSR0 and AFSR1 and FAR and MAIR and VBAR and CONTEXTIDR and AMAIR and CNTKCTL and ELR and SPSR and ZCR and SCTLR2, while TPIDR_EL0 and TPIDRRO_EL0 and TPIDR_EL1 and PAR_EL1 and DACR32 plus IFSR32 plus DBGVCR32 plus NVHCR target same named hardware, and any other selector warns once with no hardware effect.

Sixty four bit exception entry supports only EL1 privileged thread state and EL2 privileged thread state, loading vector base plus control from matching privilege level and saving prior program counter into matching link register.

Sixty four bit new processor state preserves condition flags plus DIT plus PAN, forces PAN when span control clear, adds tag control when memory tagging present, derives synchronous bit from control, sets debug plus async plus irq plus fiq masks plus target mode, and clears user override plus single step plus illegal execution plus branch type, saving old state into saved status for target.
Saved status routing for sixty four bit exceptions uses EL1 or EL2 shadow selected by target when virtualized host extensions active, and otherwise uses EL1 shadow regardless of target.

Thirty two bit exception status preserves condition plus saturation plus DIT plus greater-equal plus async plus fast interrupt state, clears interrupt continue plus illegal execution, forces irq mask plus mode, conditionally forces async mask except for undefined and supervisor modes and fast interrupt mask only for fast interrupt mode, and derives endianness plus Thumb plus synchronous plus PAN from control bits.

Pending exception dispatch depends on guest width: thirty two bit guests handle undefined plus prefetch abort plus data abort; sixty four bit guests handle EL1 synchronous plus EL1 async error plus EL2 synchronous plus EL2 interrupt plus EL2 async error; any other code is silently ignored.

Thirty two bit exception entry builds status via dedicated constructor, computes return address as program counter plus table indexed by vector selector and Thumb state, saves converted status and link into abort or undefined banks only, and branches to high base or vector base plus offset selected by control bit thirteen.
Banked abort and undefined saved status writes target hardware banks only when virtualized host extensions active with registers loaded, and otherwise target virtual CPU context save area.

Sixty four bit instruction skip advances program counter by one word and clears branch type plus single step saved bit, while thirty two bit path delegates to width aware helper and also clears single step saved bit.

Counter index translation treats cycle index specially with dedicated filter and count names and treats event indexes as base plus index for both event type selector and count value selector, with event register reads going through that translation.

Counts at decisions compare paired exclusion flags for EL0 and EL1 inside event register for equality, while EL2 decision additionally denies non hyp counters when hypervisor debug control hides them and otherwise tests include flag, and enabled decision requires enable set bit plus hypervisor enable for hyp counters or global enable otherwise.

Event creation always stops prior backing first, uses cycle type for cycle index else event register masked by version derived mask, skips software increment and chained types plus filtered out plus unmappable types, pins backing, sets disabled from enabled predicate, always excludes hypervisor and host, derives user exclusion from EL0 predicate and kernel exclusion from EL2 predicate in hyp context else EL1 predicate, marks wide counters, and sizes initial period from current value with overflow handler attached.
Event identifier mask derives from virtual machine debug feature register performance version field, delegating version to width mapping helper.

Cycle counter is always wide while event counters are wide only with recent performance version, overflow width follows hypervisor long control for hyp counters else global long controls, and initial period is negated current value masked to full or low half width.

Observed counter value is architectural register plus live backing delta when backing exists, truncated to low half when narrow, and stopping snapshots that observed value back into architectural register before releasing backing.

Range application walks from start to end in bounded chunks invoking supplied callback per chunk, optionally yielding write lock between chunks, and treats missing page table as success if lock was previously dropped else invalid argument.

Virtualized control mapping validates non hyp context plus valid pseudo entry plus matching translation enable state plus matching address plus matching address space identifier when non global, then chooses full kernel or read only kernel or no access from writability and permission flags, installing per CPU fixmap and mapped flag only when accessible.
Stage2 unmap range helper requires caller to hold virtual machine address lock for write, asserted internally.
Range walker may temporarily release address write lock between chunks to allow scheduling, remembering that drop to tolerate concurrent page table teardown.
Control mapping helper holds non preemptible scope plus address read lock for its validation and fixmap installation.
Performance counter object embeds index used to locate owning virtual CPU by container linkage into per virtual CPU performance array slot.
Thirty two bit abort and undefined link values live in general register compat slots for respective modes, paired with saved status banks described above.

Virtual control pseudo entry carries validity plus guest address plus host address plus writability plus owning CPU plus cached walk result including global plus identifier plus write and read permissions and translation state.

Program counter resolution prefers pending exception path which injects then clears pending plus mask, and only when no pending exception takes increment path which skips one instruction then clears increment.

Sixty four bit vector choice compares current mode against target: same privileged thread state uses one current level vector, same privilege with thread bit difference uses second current level vector, otherwise lower level vectors distinguished by current width.

Thumb block state machine stays idle for ARM state or empty block mask, otherwise rotates condition and mask bits forward clearing all when sequence completes, invoked after every thirty two bit skip.
Nested performance transition scans low thirty two enable bits, recreates backing only where EL1 and EL2 counting differ, and performs single guest restore if any recreation happened.
Hyp program counter adjustment is invoked after exit handling to either enter pending guest exception or advance past trapped instruction.
Stage2 unmap range is callable with machine plus start plus size and blocking hint to tear down second stage entries, safe to call for protected guests as no operation.
Level one virtual control mapper is invoked to opportunistically establish kernel mapping for nested control page, safely bailing out when racing state invalidates request.
Requesting sixty four bit exception entry to any target besides EL1 or EL2 privileged thread states triggers fatal abort.
Writing unrecognized selector through EL1 to hardware mapper warns once and performs no hardware write, leaving hardware stale.
Unmap helper warns on non page multiple size and on per chunk unmap callback failure.
Unknown performance version warns once and yields zero event mask, causing all event selections to collapse to zero.
Write only or inaccessible control page cannot be mapped in kernel; implementation leaves it unmapped and expects later fault translation, with write only noted as unsupported.
Backing performance creation failure is logged once and leaves counter without backing while retaining stopped architectural value.
Concurrent page table teardown during range walk surfaces as invalid argument only when lock was never dropped; otherwise walk reports success despite absent table.
Thirty two bit injection pairs undefined mode with offset 4, abort mode with offset 12 for prefetch abort, and abort mode with offset 16 for data abort.
Thirty two bit vector base is high address FFFF0000 hex when control bit thirteen set, otherwise virtual barrier base plus offset.
Performance event identifier mask is ten low bits for base version and sixteen low bits for versions 3.1 and 3.4 and 3.5 and 3.7.
Performance counter set scanned for nested transition is thirty two indexes from enable set register.
Event counter type and value registers are contiguous bases indexed by counter number, with dedicated cycle filter and cycle count names for cycle index.
Sixty four bit skip advances program counter by 4 and clears branch type field and single step saved bit; thirty two bit Thumb compressed skip advances by 2 else 4.
